name: AttachedResources
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/AttachedResources
summary: An attached-resources card in a resource settings tab, here its domains: a borderless table of the addresses the resource answers on, each with its environment, deployment policy and certificate as medium rounded tags and a row actions menu, over a footer that counts them and adds one. Rendered in the Domains section of a resource’s Settings tab, where an environment-less domain leaves its Environment and Policy cells empty and the count reads domain or domains. Built from `Card`, `Table`, `Tag`, `DropdownMenu`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip` and `Button`.
